title: BC Community 2025 Wrapped - Blogs, Videos, etc
summary: A year-long analysis of Business Central community blogging activity from December 2024 through November 2025 reveals 1,476 posts from 81 sources, with AL development, AI/Copilot integration, and reporting as dominant topics. The analysis demonstrates how AI-assisted tools can efficiently process large datasets to uncover community trends and engagement patterns.
key_points: BC community produced 1,476 blog posts across 81 unique sources averaging 4 posts daily, with Yun Zhu leading contributors at 486 pieces of content
AL development dominated discussions with 996 mentions, while AI and Copilot surged with 228 combined posts, signaling major shifts in BC development priorities
Video content has become essential to BC learning, with top creators producing 752 videos demonstrating evolution from text-only to multimedia knowledge sharing
Community shows consistent monthly engagement averaging 123 posts with peaks during Wave announcements and conference season (October 2025 hit 180 posts)

quotes.text: AL (Application Language) remains the heart of Business Central development. The community is deeply engaged with coding, extensions, and customizations.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies that AL development is the central focus of the BC community, showing where developer engagement concentrates

quotes.text: The surge in AI and Copilot content signals a major shift in how we think about Business Central's future.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the growing importance of AI capabilities in BC discussions, indicating industry direction and community priorities

quotes.text: The diversity of sources (81 domains) shows a healthy mix of voices and perspectives.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates ecosystem health through varied content creators, not concentrated in single sources
